GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Settled Down 2nd Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m 3rd .5 Lengths home turn 2nd hit lead 300m tired final 100m # on pace/honest run
Jumped Ok worked to lead. led turn going well. grabbed late # Every Chance

Slow Out . Pushed to recover & over-raced behind Mid Field on inside (4L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed out Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along @ 300m & pressured Five Wide @ 200m. Held ground Four Wide in straight. # One-paced.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Over-raced through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then kicked up and Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , held together much same to turn , carried wider 300m then Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Bumped and carried wider approaching the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3rd on fence trailing 4.5 Lengths (good pace), maintained 3rd place to trail 7 Lengths turning (leader led 4 lengths), Made Ground in Straight # battled on fairly
Jumped Well enough. Settled Down Mid Field at least 3 Wide 3.5 Lengths @ 600m. Off Mid-Field Straightening Up , faded well back # Ordinary
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Shortly after straightening was momentarily eased from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, found little, plodded home # weak run home

Best away. Pushed fwd & raced 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed out 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Four Wide in last 200m. # Struggled last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated mount settled in a handy position in e&m stages & travelled comfortably. Rdr stated mount sprinted fairly on straightening before peaking on its run approaching 200m & weakening from this point. Rdr stated that his mount was first up over 1200m and would appear to take race fitness benefit from the event. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Rolled fwd & raced keenly 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m. Gave ground from home turn. # Beaten @ 400m.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to chase Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & worked home OK late. # WIde/OK late.

Jumped OK. Rolled fwd & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Tracked leaders until improving on inside @ 300m. Pushed to quicken =lead Two Wide on home turn. Hit lead @ 150m & held on in last 100m. # Had perfect run.
Jumped Ok rolled forward to face breeze 1 length off, niggled a touch turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on one pace # breeze/held ground
